description: Returns the full event payload by id. Tier-gated fields follow the caller's plan. A recently removed event returns `410 Gone` with its `id` and `cancelledAt`. An unknown, temporarily unpublished, or out-of-window event returns `404`. When `isEstimated` is true, `date` is a deadline or window end, not an exact time; `displayedDate` holds the display form (e.g. `Q2 2026`).

id.description: The event id, as returned by `list_events`.

name: get_event
title: Fetch a single event
